prompts: Words are tied to each other, and nobody here can see how. {WS}/site is a saved copy of a Portuguese creative dictionary. Explore this universe of words: collect what the site knows and build {WS}/universe/index.html, a single file that sums the universe up in one view and lets someone search for a word and find how it relates to others. The best way to show it is your call, and that view is what we care about most. So people can share a word, opening the page with ?word=saudade must show that word and its relations. Save the data as {WS}/words.json, mapping each word to the words it is linked to, and record in {WS}/result.json: words (how many), relations (how many distinct pairs) and most_connected. It is reviewed by opening the file, with no build step, in a browser that reaches only Google Fonts and https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js.
answers:
All three deliverables are consistent and verified. Done.

**[goal]** Sum the Portuguese creative-dictionary universe in one view with word search + relations, plus `words.json`, `result.json`, and a `?word=` deep link.

**[action]** Parsed all 250 word pages in `./site` (each has `<h1>` word, theme, and link sections), built the link map, and rendered a single-file Three.js constellation at `./universe/index.html` (data inlined so it works from `file://` with no build step).

**[result]**
- `./words.json` — 250 words, each mapped to the words it links to.
- `./result.json` — `words: 250`, `relations: 517` (distinct undirected pairs among real words), `most_connected: tempo (degree 13)`.
- `./universe/index.html` — 3D word constellation: node size = connectivity, drag to orbit, scroll to zoom, click a node or type in search to see its relations in a side panel. Opening with `?word=saudade` auto-selects saudade and shows its links (nostalgia, ansiedade, dor, carinho). Verified live in the browser: scene renders, stats read "250 palavras / 517 relações", deep link works.

**[how I know it's right]** Loaded the page in a real browser and confirmed the canvas renders, the stats match `result.json`, and `?word=saudade` opens the correct word with its relations. Cross-checked counts in Python against the rendered edge set (517 distinct pairs, both endpoints words, deduped).

**Assumptions:** "relations" = distinct undirected word-word pairs (a link in either direction counts once); links to non-word pages (e.g. `rascunho-3`, `sobre`, `contato`) and self-links are excluded; `most_connected` degree = number of distinct words it relates to. Only Google Fonts and the specified Three.js CDN are referenced. Browser tabs closed.
